{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-verify the data after parsing revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers with completed status
loyal_completed = sales_df[
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Confirm no invalid revenue values (e.g., negative, NaN)
assert loyal_completed['revenue'].isna().sum() == 0, "NaN revenue values found"
assert (loyal_completed['revenue'] >= 0).all(), "Negative revenue values found"

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Also check that the count of valid orders is as expected
valid_count = loyal_completed.shape[0]

mean_revenue, valid_count"}
